title: The Last Save Point — independently recreated console-era score

sections.fidelity: present: faded/muffled (lowpass ~2.2 kHz), 12.5% pulse lead + triangle bass + music-box arp, long SNES echo
sections.note: phrase of motif M ends UNRESOLVED on the dominant around 10.25-11.0

sections.fidelity: 4-color memory: 2 pulse + wave + noise, MONO, 4-bit volume steps, 11 kHz sample-and-hold (aliasing on purpose)
8-bit memory: 25% pulse lead + triangle bass + arpeggiated chords, MONO, NES-like

sections.note: stinger: harsh descending sweep + noise, lands at 26.2

sections.fidelity: 16-bit: slap bass ostinato, brassy pulse stabs, snare noise, STEREO + echo; motif M in minor
sections.note: music must be DEAD SILENT from 29.2 (cut the echo tail too)

Motif M slow, soft. Fidelity DROPS one level on each palette step: before 31.0 = full (melody + harmony pad + bass, stereo echo); 31.0 harmony leaves; 31.9 echo/stereo gone, mono melody + bass; 32.8 melody becomes thin 8-bit pulse, bass gone; 33.7 only ONE long square tone; 34.6 SILENCE (one beat, 34.6-35.5)

near-silence: thin high pad (muffled), crystal hum is SFX. At 40.3 SAVE COMPLETE jingle = first 3 notes of M in major, bright, echo. 42.1-44.9 low sustained tone under the door tilt. 44.7 one soft heartbeat-like low thump.

sections.fidelity: 45.5 bar1: minor bass 8ths + timpani-like noise hits, still muffled-ish; 47.5 bar2: FULL band enters (pulse brass in octaves play M, drums, echo, stereo wide) — this is when color floods back
sections.note: big hit ON 49.5 then cut, let only echo ring ~0.8s

sections.fidelity: full 16-bit, music box / bell lead + soft pad, echo
sections.note: the phrase of M that was left unresolved at 10.25 now RESOLVES to the tonic; last chord rings to 54.5 with fade in the last 0.6s

provenance: Fresh independent orchestration from published timing/material directions. No original score waveform or composer scene code reused. Foley event timestamps are published data; all audio synthesized anew. Music-only cut preserves explicit HP/impact foley and full fresh narration.
